label: baseline-inp
method: manual: Chrome DevTools Performance panel, worst interaction per page load; cross-checked with a PerformanceObserver on 'event' entries
throttling: CPU 4x slowdown, network Slow 4G — matches the Lighthouse mobile preset used for perf/runs/baseline.json
interaction: typing "biedronka" into the transaction search field at a normal pace, after the page had settled
notes: Lighthouse reports no INP for a navigation. TBT (1524 ms, perf/runs/baseline.json) is the lab proxy; this file is the interaction measurement, taken by hand on the untouched build before any fix.

The worst interaction changes shape between runs but has a single cause. In run 2 the cost is processing: React re-renders 8000 rows synchronously inside the input handler, since updates from discrete events are not deferred. In run 3 the worst interaction is a keystroke that spent 717 ms in input delay, queued behind the previous render.

Per-event and per-interaction timings attribute the same interaction differently. On a controlled input the keydown entry has no listener of its own, so its processing reads ~0 and the work falls into its presentation delay; DevTools groups keydown/input/keyup by interactionId and reports that work as processing. The per-interaction numbers are the ones recorded here.
DevTools flagged a forced reflow during the same recording. Not investigated yet.
